commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, json
nu=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
cases=[
'1 + 2','3 * (4 + 5)','1 / 2','5 mod 2','2 ** 8','true','null','\"hello\"','\\'hi\\'','[1 2 3]','{a: 1, b: \"x\"}','[[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]]',
'[1 2 3] | each {|x| "'$x * 2 }'"','[1 2 3] | where "'$it > 1'"','[3 1 2] | sort','[1 2 3] | length','\"hello\" | str upcase','\" hello \" | str trim','\"abc\" | str contains b',
'{a: 1} | to json','[{a: 1, b: x} {a: 2, b: y}] | to json','[{a: 1, b: x} {a: 2, b: y}] | to csv','\"a,b\\\\n1,2\" | from csv','pwd','1 == 1','1 "'!= 2'"','3 > 2','not false','if true { 1 } else { 2 }','let x = 4; "'$x + 1'"','range 1..3','1..3 | each {|x| "'$x}'"',
]
for c in cases:
 p=subprocess.run([nu,'--no-config-file','-c',c],capture_output=True)
 print('\\nCASE',repr(c),'RC',p.returncode)
 print('OUT',repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')))
 print('ERR',repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')))
'@ | python -"
